title: 🪙 Welcome to the Arcade — Chips are live!
body: The MadLadsLab Arcade now has a site-wide chip economy. Earn chips by playing the arcade and hopping on the servers, then spend them at the craps & roulette tables. Climb the Most Chips and Biggest Bet Won leaderboards. This is an active work in progress — new games, betting boards, and rewards are landing regularly. Have fun, and tell us what you want next.
author: MadLadsLab
